proof_scope: live provider dispatch and live multi-seat panels through the real Ask runtime

claims.proves: that a seat either answers with real content or names its blocker, that a rate-limited seat self-recovers to its configured fallback AND records the substitution, that no seat dispatches a nonexistent model, that a live roundtable reaches three ANSWERING seats and passes its own compliance audit, that a live competition reaches two answering candidates, that a two-seat panel is refused rather than reported as a panel, and that an MVP unblock dispatches isolated candidates against a real blocker and passes the best-practices-competition audit while refusing a solo candidate
claims.does_not_prove: that any given provider is available at run time, or semantic correctness of any response. Quorum is a floor on delivery, not on quality: three seats returning the token proves the transport seats a panel, never that the panel is right.

cases.name: live-no-seat-dispatches-a-nonexistent-model
command: cd .. && ./run.sh live-seat-probe claude-fable-low --json 2>/dev/null | grep -c model_not_available || true

cases.name: a-non-selected-tab-is-hidden-so-seats-need-own-windows
command: cd ../../surf && OUT=$(./run.sh window.new 'https://example.com' --unfocused 2>&1) && W=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -oE 'Window [0-9]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}') && T1=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -oE 'tab [0-9]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}') && T2=$(./run.sh tab.new 'https://example.org' --background --window-id "$W" 2>&1 | grep -oE 'tab [0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}') && A=$(./run.sh js --tab-id "$T1" --no-activate 'document.hidden' 2>&1 | tail -1) && B=$(./run.sh js --tab-id "$T2" --no-activate 'document.hidden' 2>&1 | tail -1) && ./run.sh window.close "$W" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "selected=$A second=$B"; case "$A$B" in *false*true*) echo SECOND_TAB_IS_HIDDEN;; esac

cases.name: live-a-removed-web-seat-is-refilled-locally-and-recorded
command: cd .. && ./run.sh tau-dag 'Reply with exactly: SUBSTITUTE-OK' --repo local/agent-skills --target eval-substitute --immutable-goal 'Return the token or name a blocker.' --handler webgemini --execute --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,re,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();m=re.search(r'^{',t,re.M);d=json.loads(t[m.start():]);sel=(d.get('execution') or {}).get('browser_provider_selection') or d.get('browser_provider_selection') or {};subs=sel.get('local_substitutions') or [];rem=sel.get('removed_handlers') or [];assert not rem or subs, ('a seat was removed with no recorded substitution', rem);print('SEAT_HONEST')"

cases.name: an-ambient-rate-limited-tab-does-not-remove-a-seat
an-unbound-browser-run-opens-a-fresh-tab
command:
cd .. && uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src')
import ask.tau_dag_cli as c
class I:
    handlers=['webgpt']; workflow_mode='single'; handler_projects=[]
# reuse-bound with nothing bound is what let 20 ambient tabs decide availability
import inspect
src=inspect.getsource(c._provision_browser_lifecycle)
assert 'unbound' in src, 'unbound runs no longer choose a fresh tab'
print('FRESH_TAB_WHEN_UNBOUND')"

cases.name: live-webdeepseek-reads-an-attached-image

Answer with the single species name only.' > "$IN" && ./run.sh deepseek.submit --input "$IN" --output "$OUT" --mode Vision --attach-file ../ask/fixtures/lion.jpg --timeout 400 >/dev/null 2>&1; test -s "$OUT" && grep -qi lion "$OUT" && echo VISION_READ_THE_IMAGE

cases.name: live-a-roundtable-reaches-quorum-and-passes-its-own-audit
command: cd .. && OUT=$(./run.sh prove-workflow roundtable 2>&1); echo "$OUT" | tail -1; echo "$OUT" | grep -q 'WORKS:' || exit 1; DIR=$(echo "$OUT" | python3 -c "import json,re,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();m=re.search(r'^{',t,re.M);print(json.loads(t[m.start():t.rindex(chr(125))+1]).get('run_dir',''))" 2>/dev/null); [ -d "$DIR" ] || { echo NO_RUN_DIR; exit 1; }; ./run.sh panel-audit "$DIR" --mode roundtable

cases.name: live-a-roundtable-below-quorum-is-not-reported-as-a-panel
command: cd .. && OUT=$(./run.sh prove-workflow roundtable --handler webgpt --handler webkimi 2>&1); echo "$OUT" | grep -q 'DOES_NOT_WORK' || { echo 'TWO_SEATS_PASSED_AS_A_PANEL'; exit 1; }; DIR=$(echo "$OUT" | python3 -c "import json,re,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();m=re.search(r'^{',t,re.M);print(json.loads(t[m.start():t.rindex(chr(125))+1]).get('run_dir',''))" 2>/dev/null); [ -d "$DIR" ] || { echo NO_RUN_DIR; exit 1; }; ./run.sh panel-audit "$DIR" --mode roundtable | grep -q 'roundtable_quorum' && echo QUORUM_ENFORCED_ON_A_LIVE_RUN

cases.name: live-an-mvp-unblock-competition-produces-a-judged-winner
command: cd .. && L=$(mktemp) && ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$L uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask import blocker_ledger as b;b.record(target='eval-mvp',failure_code='surf_browser_lock_timeout',message='a lane timed out waiting for the transport lock')" >/dev/null 2>&1 && OUT=$(ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$L ./run.sh unblock --target eval-mvp --failure-code surf_browser_lock_timeout --handler webgpt --handler webgemini --handler webgrok --execute 2>/dev/null) && DIR=$(echo "$OUT" | python3 -c "import json,re,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();m=re.search(r'^{',t,re.M);d=json.loads(t[m.start():t.rindex(chr(125))+1]);print(str((d.get('execution') or {}).get('receipt_dir') or '').replace('/tau-receipts',''))") && [ -d "$DIR" ] && ./run.sh panel-audit "$DIR" --mode compete

cases.name: live-an-mvp-competition-with-one-candidate-is-refused
command: cd .. && L=$(mktemp) && ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$L uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask import blocker_ledger as b;b.record(target='eval-mvp-solo',failure_code='eval_solo_code')" >/dev/null 2>&1; ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$L ./run.sh unblock --target eval-mvp-solo --failure-code eval_solo_code --handler webgpt --execute 2>&1 | grep -q 'at least 2 isolated candidates' && echo SOLO_MVP_COMPETITION_REFUSED

cases.name: ask-primary-live-answer-receipt-backend
command:
OUT=$(cd .. && ./run.sh ask 'Reply with exactly ASK-PRIMARY-OK and no other text.' --oracle --oracle-backend scillm --oracle-timeout 600 --json 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$OUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();d=json.loads(t[t.find('{'):t.rfind('}')+1]);a=str(d.get('answer') or '');o=d.get('oracle') or {};r=d.get('route_decision') or {};assert 'ASK-PRIMARY-OK' in a,a;assert d.get('ask_id'),d;assert d.get('runtime_artifacts'),d;assert o.get('backend')=='scillm',o;assert o.get('model_served'),o;assert r.get('selected_backend')=='scillm',r;print('ASK_PRIMARY_RECEIPT_OK')"

cases.name: ask-primary-no-seat-fails-closed
command: OUT=$(cd .. && ./run.sh ask 'Reply with exactly SHOULD-NOT-APPEAR.' --oracle --oracle-backend webkimi --kimi-tab-id 999999999 --oracle-timeout 90 --json 2>&1 || true); printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();d=json.loads(t[t.find('{'):t.rfind('}')+1]);a=str(d.get('answer') or '').strip();assert 'SHOULD-NOT-APPEAR' not in a,a;o=d.get('oracle') or {};err=o.get('error') or d.get('error') or {};n=d.get('needs_attention') or {};blocker=err.get('type') or err.get('message') or n.get('reason');assert blocker,d;assert not a,a;print('ASK_NO_SEAT_BLOCKED BLOCKER='+str(blocker)[:60])"

cases.name: intent-llm-stage-contract
command: Q="Explain the relationship between metacognition and transfer learning nonce-$RANDOM-$RANDOM"; OUT=$(cd .. && ./run.sh intent "$Q" --json 2>&1); printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();d=json.loads(t[t.find('{'):t.rfind('}')+1]);assert d.get('intent') in {'TOPIC_QUERY','TOPIC_LEARN'},d;assert d.get('stage')=='llm',d;c=d.get('confidence');assert isinstance(c,(int,float)) and 0.5<=c<=1,d;print('INTENT_LLM_CONTRACT_OK')"
